stories.quote: We used to rely on OTAs for most surf-week packages. Once beds, lessons and weekly bundles lived on our own store, guests started booking direct — and we stopped retyping the same reservation details into three places.
stories.name: Marta Silva

stories.quote: Retreat season used to mean chasing deposits in email and updating a shared spreadsheet every morning. Now balances, dietary notes and room moves sit on the booking — and the team opens one day planner instead of five tabs.
stories.name: Elena Vasquez

stories.quote: Lodge beds, guided hikes and partner agent bookings all shared the same calendar chaos. Hightide let us sell the full stay online, then run arrivals, payments and partner settlements from the same booking record.
stories.name: James Okonkwo
